hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: MEMORY: if the topic touches history/preferences/projects/accounts/design, READ the relevant vault note (don't guess). If new permanent knowledge appeared (preference, decision, account, project, correction), WRITE it to the vault + add one line to MEMORY.md; without asking, notify briefly. The brief's LAST paragraph is the most critical rule; in-session 'don't do X' bans hold for the whole session. Outside RED (money / irreversible deletion / legal / a client's live site / domains) never ask for permission.
